messages:
jessica: Heads up — after the 12:05 deploy the latency dashboard (infra > inference-prod > latency percentiles panel id 42) is only showing p50/avg. p95/p99 lines are gone for all models. Not an alert (yet) but customers are asking about SLO visibility. Anyone seen this?

deploy-bot: rolled out ingest-aggregator v2 to prod at 2026-10-12T12:05:30Z by pipeline #789 :rocket:

mike: can you paste the panel's promql and a screenshot?

jessica: panel query (was):
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
```
We still see p50 from other panels but p95 returns no series.

danny: suspicious — if the 'le' label disappeared the histogram_quantile will fail. Did the aggregator change how histograms are exported in v2? Running a quick check...

ops-oncall: ran a scrape against the prometheus target, here's what I see for the request duration metric (trimmed):
```text
# HELP redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket Buckets for request duration
redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{model="gpt-3",le="0.1"} 0
redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{model="gpt-3"} 12345
```
looks like some series lost the 'le' label on the bucket lines, which would break histogram_quantile.

jessica: confirming logs from ingest-aggregator: `INFO Dropping bucket labels to reduce cardinality for v2 pipeline`

danny: yep that's the root cause. v2 intentionally flattened histogram exports (removed 'le') to lower cardinality. histogram_quantile requires the 'le' label, so panels that use it return empty.

mike: any quick workaround so dashboards show percentiles again for users?

danny: short term: switch panels to use the precomputed percentile timeseries we already emit: `redwood_request_duration_percentile{quantile=\"0.95\"}`. That will restore p95/p99 visuals quickly. Longer term we should either re-export full buckets or provide a compat exporter.

jessica: i'm going to patch the dashboard now to point at the percentiles as a stopgap and add a note in the panel description.

rachel: what's the customer impact? Are SLO alerts affected?

danny: SLO alerts that rely on histogram_quantile are impacted. Our main SLO alerting uses precomputed SLO metrics so alerting didn't fire, but manual inspection via the percentile panels was broken. Recommend we update any alert queries that used histogram_quantile to use the precomputed metrics where appropriate.

jessica: patch applied — changed panels to `redwood_request_duration_percentile{quantile=\"0.95\"}` for the relevant panels. p95/p99 lines are back visually :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: created follow-up task INF-4321 (ingest: reintroduce histogram export or provide exporter compatibility) via CI

danny: next steps: i'll open a PR to: A) revert the 'drop le' behavior in v2 or B) add an exporter that emits both bucketed (with 'le') and percentile series. ETA 3-5h for a PR + canary. Will update the ticket.

ops-oncall: runbook updated with rollback steps and a dashboard-mapping note (which panels are safe to switch to precomputed percentiles). If anyone sees missing series after future aggregator changes, ping #eng-platform and mention INF-4321.

jessica: thanks all — closing this thread for now. follow-up ticket INF-4321.
